name: Grade 6 T1 Practice: March Week 4 - Safe Communication and Websites
description: Practice words for safe communication and basic website planning.

words.definition: Able to be seen by many people.
words.example: A public post can be seen by many people.
A private message is not for everyone.

words.definition: The people who see or hear a message.
words.example: Think about the audience before posting.

words.definition: Approval to do or share something.
words.example: Ask permission before sharing a photo.
The student planned one web page.
The title tells visitors the topic.

words.definition: A list of choices or links.
words.example: The menu helped visitors find pages.

words.definition: Something you click to open another page or place.
words.example: The link opened a useful website.
The image made the page easier to understand.

words.definition: One organized part of a page.
words.example: The first section introduced the topic.
